# Porcom

> Porcom is a free movie and TV show journal for iPhone, in French and English, and the app version of the Porcom microblog (porcom.tumblr.com). Log episodes, watch trailers, give each title a verdict and see your hours on screen. No account, no ads: your journal is stored on your iPhone and in your private iCloud. Made by Wibeset in Canada.

Key facts:

- Platform: iPhone only (not available on Android or the web). Available on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6825954523
- Price: free, with no ads, no subscription and no account.
- Privacy: titles, viewing sessions, notes and verdicts are stored on the device and synced with the user's private iCloud; the developer never receives them.
- Adding titles: search by title (data from TMDB) or type a title in by hand. A series is tracked one season at a time.
- Verdicts: the blog's four, 👎 Bof (Meh), 👍 Aimé (Liked), ❤️ Adoré ! (Loved it!), 🔥 Dévoré ! (Devoured!), plus optional 1–5 star ratings by theme.
- Trailers: each title's page opens on its YouTube trailer, played in the app once the viewer taps play.
- Where to watch: Canadian subscription services, from JustWatch data provided by TMDB.
- Progress: by episode; each update is saved as a viewing session that feeds statistics in hours, streaks, a yearly goal, twelve levels, milestones and a year in review.
- Lists: to watch, watching, watched, abandoned, and Spotted (titles seen in a trailer, often not released yet).
- Offline: everything works without a connection, except searching, images and trailers.
- Letterboxd: exports watched movies as a CSV file in Letterboxd's import format.
- Backups: synced with iCloud; a Porcom backup file can also be exported and restored on another iPhone.
- Widgets: the next episode of a series waits on the Home Screen and Lock Screen.
- What to watch: a wheel picks among titles to watch, or among TMDB recommendations; the home screen suggests an idea for tonight when nothing is under way.
- Library: a poster wall, finished titles grouped by year, seasons of a series and movies of a saga stacked together, and rewatches recorded as new viewings.
- Challenges: a monthly challenge, Halloween and Christmas challenges, and secret milestones.
- Sharing: a title, the calendar, the year or the watchlist, as an image or text.
- Releases: first released in October 2026; version 1.1 in November 2026 (latest 1.1.3). Release notes: https://porcom.app/whats-new/

## Pages

- [Home](https://porcom.app/): features and frequently asked questions
- [Support](https://porcom.app/support/): contact, backups, missing titles, trailers, Letterboxd
- [Privacy policy](https://porcom.app/privacy/): what information the app handles
- [TV show tracker](https://porcom.app/tv-show-tracker/): Follow every series, episode by episode
- [Movie diary](https://porcom.app/movie-diary/): The date, the verdict and every rewatch
- [Watchlist](https://porcom.app/watchlist-app/): Titles to watch, spotted in a trailer
- [Year in review](https://porcom.app/year-in-review/): Your year on screen, ready to share
- [Where to watch](https://porcom.app/where-to-watch/): Streaming services in Canada
- [TV Time alternative](https://porcom.app/tv-time-alternative/): TV Time shut down: keep tracking your shows
- [Letterboxd alternative](https://porcom.app/letterboxd-alternative/): Movies and series, in private
- [Trakt alternative](https://porcom.app/trakt-alternative/): No account, no subscription
- [Serializd alternative](https://porcom.app/serializd-alternative/): Movies too, without a social feed
- [What’s new](https://porcom.app/whats-new/): Every version of Porcom
